hooks.name: Spec conformity check on tool save
hooks.description: Checks spec conformity after modifying an MCP tool

action.prompt: An MCP tool was just modified in src/tools/. Check that the implementation still conforms to the corresponding section in .kiro/specs/mcp-context-manager/design.md. Verify: typed Input/Output match, correct thresholds (60%/80%), "Resume here" section present in export_summary, error handling with try/catch and isError:true. Report any divergence from specs without modifying the code.
